criteria.reason: Copy Last, Next, and Done are rendered together in the keypad action row.
Done uses one-third of the flex row instead of spanning the keypad width.
Buttons have 14px vertical padding and text, yielding at least a 44px touch target.
The callback updates the previous set's same-field value, but the keypad's displayed value is not updated to show it.
The weight keypad's Next callback opens the reps keypad for the same set.
The buttons use design tokens for backgrounds and radius, but Done's text color is hard-coded as #fff.
The actions use a flexible row layout that fits within the keypad on mobile.
Button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all 197 server and 290 client tests passed.
A new test checks that Copy Last's handler is called, but does not verify copying the previous set's field value.
